title: Musie exercise config
description: One file says what an exercise is. Written by /exercise-builder, read by a person. Nothing in the app reads a config at runtime yet — see docs/EXERCISE-MODEL.md. This schema is the structural half of the contract; the rules it cannot express (a cut matrix covering every answer, two locales holding the same question ids in the same order) live in apps/web/src/lib/exerciseConfig.ts and are checked by validateConfig.

id.description: exercises.id. Never renamed to match a display name: sessions.exercise_id and every diary entry point at it.

kind.description: exercises.kind. Which screens the run has is STEP_IDS and exerciseKind.ts, not this file.

implemented.description: false suspends the content rules and keeps the structural ones, so an unfinished exercise is a legal config rather than a wall of empty fields.

modes.description: Null where the exercise draws no card: there is nothing physical to lay out, so analogue-or-digital does not arise. The three-state shape exercises.asks_posture uses.

cardsDealt.description: How many a digital hand holds, and therefore WHICH second step the run has: more than one is select, one is view.

library.description: The exercise before anybody starts it: what /exercises shows.

needs.description: Null where the exercise needs nothing. Not '': the intro's needs_note feature is derived from this being non-null.

run.description: The steps, in STEP_IDS order. A card exercise that offers both modes carries scan tagged analogue AND select tagged digital, in one array: that is two runs written once, not a run with two second steps.

textLocales.description: Locales with TEXT. May be wider than locales, and saying so is the point: Klangreise has English text and no English recording.

headline.description: The ## line of exercise_i18n.<step>_md, lifted out so it can be a field.

placeholder.description: reflect only. Plain text — it is an attribute on an input, so ## would reach the reader.

continueLabel.description: Absent falls back to the chrome MessageKey.

copyOverride.description: Only the fields that differ in that mode. Legal only where modes.offers includes it.

id.description: Scoped to its own set, NOT a member of a global union. q-01 in two exercises is two different questions.

listen.description: Shown under the player while the recording runs.

reflect.description: The same thought, asked again on the reflect step.

mode.description: Binds the step to one mode. scan is analogue; select and view are digital.

features.description: Only names the app enumerates — STEP_FEATURES in exerciseConfig.ts, per step. An unknown feature is a validation error, never a screen that renders nothing.

ask.description: intro only. Null means the question does not arise; an omitted key means do not ask. A config may switch a question off and preselect an answer; it cannot add an option.

cuts.description: listen only. Names the answer matrix in exercise_cuts' own vocabulary, with any for its nulls. It may NOT carry mixed_src, voice_src, duration_seconds, intro_until or track_id: those belong to music.json, and a second writer of exercise_cuts is the overlap CLAUDE.md 4.1 exists to prevent.

questions.description: listen only, and only with rotating_question. Every locale holds the same ids in the same order: the rotation indexes by position.

copySource.description: chrome means this step has no content columns and every word it shows is a MessageKey in i18n/*. True of select and view today. Their copy is expected to be empty, and the content rules are skipped for them.
